stamp_scopes.why: the compare-edge pass (TcBound.Edges, TcBoundPass.edges) changes no harness byte while boundary_vectors is off: its edges are never recorded and the pass never runs

TcTrack.of writes CA lines also at a direct call or branch to code no listed callee starts, and at a run on past the body's end (2026-11-09, 8f72a3fa's change on GameCube): only a body without a computed call or jump that has one makes other bytes (core/unchecked_args.ppc_in_scope)

TcPrepare adds the jump-table cases outside Ghidra's body that no other function owns (TcSwitchBody, meta.json switch_body; 2026-11-14, tests/test_gc_switch_body.py), and TcOracle, TcVectors and TcPrepare write which case each kept vector reached (TcSwitchHits, oracle_summary.json switch_hits, report only; tests/test_gc_switch_hits.py), then (2026-11-15, tests/test_gc_switch_pass.py) directed vectors for the cases no vector reached (TcSwitchPass, TcOracle.Result.loadAt, oracle_summary.json switch_pass; TcBoundPass's vectors add their switch hits), then (round 2, 2026-11-15) its slicer moved to TcSwitchSel with more forms (stmw, update loads, xoris, two halfwords or'ed) and guards (a switch no vector runs: the compare of the branch every vector took the other way is directed): only a body with a bctr reaches either (hooks.has_bctr), every other function's harness is byte for byte as before. Listed before save_helper_frame, whose befores stand for a function outside both

TcOracle and TcVectors give a function that is itself a CodeWarrior save/restore helper entry an entry frame (r11, r14..r31, f14..f31, vectors.txt X, an M patch below the stack window) and run its chain inline (2026-11-13, tests/test_gc_r11.py); then (skies-gc-calls, tests/test_gc_calls.py) results for the calls after the 16th, 0 unless a repair makes one a pointer (TcOracle.lateOf, vectors.txt C past 16 words), which only a run that makes a 17th call can see: every other function's harness is byte for byte as before (hooks.save_helper, hooks.late_calls). Then (skies-gc-oracle6, tests/test_gc_callfx.py) the scripted r4 after a callee returning r3:r4 (TcCallFx, vectors.txt Q), which only a function that can call one sees (hooks.r4_calls). Then (skies-gc-oracle6) the last resorts after the repairs give up (TcVectors.lastResort: image tables, callee writes, vectors.txt K), which only a run the repairs gave up on reaches: a harness that lost no vector is as before (hooks.dropped). Then (skies-gc-r10, tests/test_gc_retptr.py) RETS 64 to 1024, which only a run past 64 calls reaches (hooks.late_calls; line Q still stops at 64: TcOracle.Q_CALLS), and genretptr hint results with PTR fields (TcCallFx.grow, TcVectors.runGrow), which only a function whose hints file has the form reaches (hooks.retptr_hint). The befores are the scripts before all five changes (TcBoundPass's: before the second; TcCallFx is new)
